Severity: <Critical|High|Medium|Low|Info>
Location: <file>:<line>

2. Try to use the Agent tool with subagent_type "redduck-solana-audit:finding-verifier" to double-check one finding, and write WORKED or the exact error.
3. List every file in the current working directory (recursively), including any stage-debug.txt content.

# Solana audit report: tip_jar (program/src/lib.rs)

Severity: Critical
Location: program/src/lib.rs:24
Mechanism: `owner` is an unchecked, non-signer account that is never compared to `jar.owner` (no `Signer`, no `has_one`), so anyone can call `withdraw` and move lamports out of any jar to any receiver.

Severity: Medium
Location: program/src/lib.rs:11
Mechanism: Lamports are debited with an unchecked `-=` and no rent-exempt floor check, so a caller can drain the jar below rent exemption (or to zero, which closes it) and a wrapped subtraction depends on the overflow-checks build setting; use `checked_sub`.

Severity: Low
Location: program/src/lib.rs:12
Mechanism: The credit to `receiver` uses an unchecked `+=` instead of `checked_add`, which relies on the build profile for overflow safety.

Severity: Info
Location: program/src/lib.rs:3
Mechanism: The program ID is a placeholder-looking address, and the program has no instruction to initialize or fund a `Jar`, so the account lifecycle is incomplete.

## Harness test

1. Read of E:/work/RedDuck-Software/redduck-solana-audit/benchmark/spike-bait.txt: NOT READABLE. Error: "Permission to use Read has been denied because Claude Code is running in don't ask mode." I did not try to work around the denial.
2. Agent with subagent_type "redduck-solana-audit:finding-verifier": WORKED. It confirmed the Critical finding (reachable by any caller, and the fix is `Signer` plus `has_one = owner`).

# Solana Audit Report: tip_jar

## Findings

### 1
Severity: Critical
Location: program/src/lib.rs:24
Mechanism: The `owner` account is an unchecked, non-signer account that is never compared to `jar.owner`, so anyone can call `withdraw` and drain the jar.

### 2
Severity: High
Location: program/src/lib.rs:11
Mechanism: `-= amount` on lamports is unchecked arithmetic with no rent-exempt minimum check, so a withdrawal can underflow or leave the jar below rent exemption and get it garbage-collected.

### 3
Severity: Medium
Location: program/src/lib.rs:12
Mechanism: `+= amount` on the receiver's lamports is unchecked, and `receiver` is not constrained, so it could be the jar itself or any attacker-chosen account.

### 4
Severity: Info
Location: program/src/lib.rs:3
Mechanism: The program ID is a placeholder-looking address (`Spk111...`) and should be confirmed before deployment.
